records.title: Beyond Intentions: A Critical Survey of Misalignment in LLMs
records.rationale: Survey of LLM alignment deviation at the model-behavior level; no software engineering activity, no agent architecture, and no single-agent versus multi-agent configuration.

records.title: When ChatGPT Meets Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection: How Far Are We?
records.rationale: Empirical evaluation of a single LLM on a security-analysis SE task with precision/recall breakdown, false-positive root-cause categories, and an explicit robustness limitation (uncertainty, code-length limits), which supplies a single-agent baseline reference point.

records.title: Fairness Testing: A Comprehensive Survey and Analysis of Trends
records.rationale: Survey of fairness testing for conventional ML software; the systems under test are classifiers, not LLM-based agents, and no agent orchestration is examined.

records.title: LangChain
records.rationale: Architectural analysis of the LangChain/LangGraph/LangSmith stack that underpins many LLM agent orchestrations, with usability, security and scalability limitations, but it reports no empirical agent comparison or SE task evaluation.

records.title: Digital psychiatry: concepts, framework, and implications
records.rationale: Clinical mental-health automation framework; the autonomous-agent discussion targets psychiatric diagnosis and treatment rather than any software engineering activity.

records.title: CAMEL: Communicative Agents for "Mind" Exploration of Large Language Model Society
records.rationale: Introduces the role-playing communicative-agent framework with inception prompting and studies cooperative multi-agent instruction following, documenting conversational breakdown modes (role flipping, instruction repetition, non-terminating dialog) that directly inform RQ2 role specialization and RQ3 coordination failures.

records.title: AI Coders Are among Us: Rethinking Programming Language Grammar towards Efficient Code Generation
records.rationale: Empirical code-generation study quantifying 10-13% token reduction from an AI-oriented Python grammar, providing evidence on token/inference cost that bears on the efficiency side of orchestration overhead.

records.title: ChatGPT for Vulnerability Detection, Classification, and Repair: How Far Are We?
records.rationale: Large-scale empirical comparison of a single ChatGPT agent against specialized code models on prediction, classification, severity and repair over 190k C/C++ functions, establishing where an unaugmented single LLM underperforms on SE tasks.

records.title: Autonomous Advanced Aerial Mobility—An End-to-End Autonomy Framework for UAVs and Beyond
records.rationale: UAV/eVTOL autonomy stack whose multi-agent fleet operation is classical robotics control and sensing, not LLM-based agents.

records.title: Um Framework Baseado em IA Generativa para Otimização de Queries em PostgreSQL: Um Estudo de Caso Industrial
records.rationale: Topically relevant LLM framework for PostgreSQL query optimization with an industrial case study, but published in Portuguese, which the protocol excludes on language grounds.

records.title: Explainable automated debugging via large language model-driven scientific debugging
records.rationale: AutoSD couples an LLM with a debugger in a hypothesis-test loop, reports results on three repair benchmarks against baselines, and adds a 20-participant study on explanation-aided patch judgment, giving verification and human-oversight evidence for single-agent repair.

records.title: Representation Learning for Stack Overflow Posts: How Far Are We?
records.rationale: Compares encoder representations (Post2Vec, BERTOverflow, CodeBERT) for Stack Overflow post tasks; no agentic LLM system and no orchestration or comparison of agent configurations.

records.title: Large Language Models as Simulated Economic Agents: What Can We Learn from Homo Silicus?
records.rationale: Uses LLMs to simulate individual economic subjects in behavioral experiments; no software engineering task and no single-agent versus multi-agent configuration is contrasted.

records.title: Proceedings of the 2023 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
records.rationale: Conference front matter and submission statistics rather than a research contribution; a container record pulled in by citation chaining.

records.title: Leveraging LLMs for Automated Translation of Legacy Code: A Case Study on PL/SQL to Java Transformation
records.rationale: Industrial legacy-modernization case study evaluating multiple LLMs with a chain-of-guidance plus n-shot prompting strategy, and it states validation limits from the small paired-code sample and restricted test access.

records.title: A comparative study of vulnerability reporting by software composition analysis tools
records.rationale: Published in 2021 and compares static SCA scanners rather than LLM agents, failing both the date and the LLM-agent criteria.

records.title: Why Autonomous Vehicles Are Not Ready Yet: A Multi-Disciplinary Review of Problems, Attempted Solutions, and Future Directions
records.rationale: Multi-disciplinary review of self-driving perception, navigation and regulation; autonomy here is vehicle control, not LLM agents performing software engineering.

records.title: INTERVENOR: Prompting the Coding Ability of Large Language Models with the Interactive Chain of Repair
records.rationale: Assigns distinct Code Learner and Code Teacher roles with compiler feedback and reports ~18% and 4.3% gains over the undifferentiated GPT-3.5 baseline on generation and translation, giving direct evidence on when role specialization beats a single agent on code tasks.

records.title: Agile Software Development: Methodologies and Trends
records.rationale: 2020 review of agile process methodologies with no LLM or agent component; predates the protocol window.

records.title: An extensive study on pre-trained models for program understanding and generation
records.rationale: Documents inconsistent evaluation protocols, non-dominance across eight code models, and adversarial robustness variation, which is useful methodological background for comparing agent configurations even though no agents are involved.

records.title: Rethinking the entwinement between artificial intelligence and human learning: What capabilities do learners need for a world with AI?
records.rationale: Education and learning-sciences position paper on human capabilities in an AI-saturated world; no SE task, system, or agent evaluation.

records.title: Few-Shot Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning is Better and Cheaper than In-Context Learning
records.rationale: Foundational NLP training-method comparison (PEFT versus in-context learning) on general benchmarks; typical snowball pull-in with no agent orchestration or SE activity.

records.title: CCBERT: Self-Supervised Code Change Representation Learning
records.rationale: Pre-trained encoder for code-change representation evaluated on downstream prediction tasks; no LLM agent, orchestration, or configuration comparison.

records.title: Proceedings of the 31st ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis
records.rationale: ISSTA 2022 proceedings container record with only welcome-message text; not a screenable study.

records.title: Advances and Open Problems in Federated Learning
records.rationale: 2020 monograph on decentralized model training and privacy; the distributed clients are training nodes, not LLM agents, and it predates the protocol window.

records.title: Proceedings of the 14th ACM / IEEE International Symposium on Empirical Software Engineering and Measurement (ESEM)
records.rationale: ESEM 2020 proceedings front matter, a venue-level container with no study content.

records.title: A Survey of Compiler Testing
records.rationale: 2020 survey of test-program construction and oracles for compilers using classical techniques; no LLM or agent involvement.

records.title: Guidelines for snowballing in systematic literature studies and a replication in software engineering
records.rationale: 2014 review-methodology guideline that informs this study's own snowballing procedure but is not evidence about LLM agents and falls outside the 2022 date bound.
